seo.title: High Touch Automotive | PPF, Ceramic Coating & Detailing in Al Quoz, Dubai
seo.description: High Touch Automotive, Warehouse 36, 17A Street, Al Quoz 2: paint protection film, ceramic coating, window tint, rim painting and interior detailing, with progress photos and a coffee bar. 4.7 from 199 reviews.
